skill.summary: AI-powered betting advisory for gaming platforms. Provides intelligent bet recommendations, risk analysis, bankroll management, and strategy optimization for crash games, dice, and casino games. Use when building automated betting bots or need AI gambling strategy guidance.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CLAWDEBET.

This skill provides AI-assisted betting analysis and recommendations using a strict advisory-only model. 
Includes session-aware analysis, bankroll management, risk controls, and strategy configuration.

All recommendations are non-executing and designed for decision support only.
